description: The ROUNDED phrase of the SOURCE clause of a report group description entry (kb/Work PB3964). ANSI X3.23-1985's SOURCE clause has no rounded phrase; ISO/IEC 1989:2002 Annex F.2 item 115 QUOTES the change: 'SOURCE allows arithmetic expressions and functions and a ROUNDED phrase'. The 2023 text is 13.18.53.2 (`[ rounded-phrase ]`) with 13.18.53.3 SR3 and 13.18.53.4 GR2. Gated by recognition, VersionConformancePass ParseArm.VisitReportSourceClause, once per written clause.
display: the ROUNDED phrase of the SOURCE clause (report group description)
citation: ISO/IEC 1989:2002 Annex F.2 (substantive changes not affecting existing programs), item 115; ISO §2023:13.18.53.2, §2023:13.18.53.3 SR3, §2023:13.18.53.4 GR2 (2023 text)
vcr: VCR row 7.45 (85->2002: SOURCE takes a ROUNDED phrase)
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. RSRD.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
FILE-CONTROL.
    SELECT PRT ASSIGN TO "RSRD.TXT".
DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD PRT REPORT IS R1.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 WN PIC S9(3) VALUE -5.
REPORT SECTION.
RD R1 PAGE LIMIT IS 10 LINES.
01 DA TYPE DETAIL LINE PLUS 1.
    02 COLUMN 1 PIC S9(3) SOURCE WN ROUNDED.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    OPEN OUTPUT PRT.
    INITIATE R1.
    GENERATE DA.
    TERMINATE R1.
    CLOSE PRT.
    STOP RUN.
